mobile.editor.notInProject: This file isn't in any project
mobile.editor.saveFailed: Not everything was saved. Check the editor for details.
mobile.terminal.info: A terminal is a login shell opened in the project folder, with the project's environment variables. The server keeps it running: leaving this page or closing the app doesn't interrupt it, and the output catches up when you come back. Typing exit closes it. The key bar adds keys the on-screen keyboard lacks: tap Ctrl or Alt once to apply it to the next key (on-screen keyboard included), tap again to lock it, and once more to turn it off; hold the arrow and page keys to repeat. Links in the terminal open in the in-app browser. Full output lets you read and copy everything the terminal has printed.
mobile.terminal.copiedTail: Too much to copy at once; copied the most recent part
mobile.browser.refused: Can't connect to this address. The service may not be running, or nothing is listening on this port.
mobile.browser.cleartext: This is an unencrypted http address, which the system doesn't allow inside the app. Open it in your browser instead.
mobile.browser.forwardInfo: This port on the server is forwarded to your phone through an encrypted tunnel, so it only opens inside the app. The tunnel closes when the app goes to the background and reconnects when you come back.
